''See also: [[Trial of Glorious Ascension Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Trial]] of Glorious Ascension serves as the initial examination for any prospective [[disciple]] entering the [[Heaven’s Glory School]]. This test consists of a steep mountain staircase characterized by pink-tinted clouds and various [[Remnant]] formations, including those with [[spirit]] and mind [[aspects]]. These [[Remnants]] manifest as physical threats, such as flickering tails or slashing claws, to challenge a climber's mental fortitude and spiritual stability. The trial is designed with [[scripts]] that prevent anyone who begins the ascent from retreating, making it a point of no return once started. The difficulty increases with every step taken. Success in the trial is measured by whether a participant reaches the summit. While reaching the top grants official status as a [[disciple]], completing the climb before sunset provides an additional reward: the ability to choose a single item from the school's [[Lesser Treasure Hall]], which contains various weapons, [[elixirs]], and [[constructs]]. Due to the extreme danger, many participants fail; approximately one-third of those who attempt it either perish or suffer permanent spiritual damage, and only one in five survivors manages to finish before the sun sets. The trial is considered a significant feat for those at lower [[advancement]] stages, such as [[Unsouled]] or [[Foundation]] stage practitioners.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The [[Trial]] of Glorious Ascension is a rigorous test featuring a staircase filled with clouds of light containing [[spirit]]-aspect and mind-aspect [[Remnant]] formations. Designed to evaluate a [[disciple]]'s determination, resolve, and [[spirit]] foundations, the trial is extremely dangerous, as one in three challengers either dies or suffers a broken [[spirit]] that prevents them from practicing [[sacred arts]]. While the trial can be completed before sunset, only one in five surviving disciples earns the right to select from the [[Lesser Treasure Hall]]. Following its occurrence, [[Whitehall]] expressed his belief that [[Lindon]] had cheated in order to pass the trial.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The [[Trial of Glorious Ascension]] uses [[spirit]]-aspect and mind-aspect [[Remnants]] to test a [[disciple]]'s resolve, determination, and [[spirit]] foundations.<ref name="cradle-01-unsouled-c12" />}}</li>
